purpose: Provider page discovery only. No final media URLs, hosted copies, credentials or movie catalogs.

providers.name: Wikimedia Commons
providers.workflow: Open a file description page, inspect its own license/author, then download Original file through the available browser. Confirm attribution and any ShareAlike terms for that particular file.
providers.qualification: Public pages and documented per-file reuse/download workflow revalidated; full automated Codex/Claude download journeys remain unqualified.
providers.login: Usually not required for public original files; retain progress if challenged.
providers.rights: Per-file license or public-domain status; Commons does not own most files and gives no blanket rights guarantee.

providers.name: Pexels
providers.workflow: Use a selected item page through the user's ordinary authorized provider workflow; save the chosen download and its item attribution. Automated collection must have applicable provider authorization.
providers.qualification: Page/license/terms inspected only; automated downloads are not advertised as qualified.
providers.login: Some features may require user browser login.
providers.rights: Pexels license has restrictions on standalone redistribution, misleading endorsement and other uses; item and depicted-person/brand rights still matter. No stock media is bundled.

providers.name: Pixabay
providers.workflow: Use the user's authorized item page/browser download, inspect its license and save authorship/attribution. Preserve pending work if login or verification is requested.
providers.qualification: Page/license/terms inspected only; automated downloads are not advertised as qualified.
providers.login: The selected item/download may require login or verification in the browser.
providers.rights: Content license permits adaptations subject to restrictions including standalone distribution, deceptive use and third-party rights. No provider files are redistributed by this package.
